Author: Gergely_Blasko
Text: @NYChichas $VKTX I’m a VK (and $NVO) holder and bull, and VK2735 looks extremely promising. But bullish doesn’t mean we should misrepresent data. This chart is misleading, especially on tolerability. Retatrutide AE numbers include titration, when GI side effects are highest. The much better-looking VK2735 figures (49% TEAE, 5% nausea, 2% discontinuation) come from post-induction maintenance in patients already treated/titrated for 21 weeks. Not apples-to-apples. VK2735 efficacy is genuinely impressive: -17.7% W21 and -21.7% W33 with no apparent plateau. But W33 continuous dosing was only n=13. Different trials, populations, titration schedules and observation periods. VK2735 may ultimately prove equally effective or better tolerated than retatrutide. I hope it does. But let the data prove it. This chart doesn’t. $LLY $NVO $VKTX

Author: topstockalerts
Text: Nektar Therapeutics said a U.S. jury awarded the company $90 million in damages in its contractual dispute with Eli Lilly over a former collaboration to develop and commercialize rezpegaldesleukin. The jury found that Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing under the companies’ licensing agreement, sending Nektar shares higher. According to an SEC filing, the verdict was issued Wednesday following a trial that began Sept. 8 in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. The $90 million award is subject to additional interest to be determined by the court. Nektar filed the lawsuit against Lilly in August 2023, alleging breaches of the licensing agreement and the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing. The jury’s verdict remains subject to post-trial proceedings, and any resulting judgment could be appealed. $NKTR $LLY
